description.zh: 顶部五态会话计数（运行 / 询问 / 出错 / 中断 / 未读）+ 对话框浮层 + 左栏工作区徽标：不展开文件夹就能看到哪个工作区在跑、哪个在等你回答；右栏另有长任务进度视图。
description.en: Five-state session counters in the conversation header, a pinned detail panel, and per-workspace badges in the left rail — see where work is running and where it is waiting on you, without expanding every folder. A Progress tab adds long-task progress.
